ability.name: DC Verification and Router Gate
ability.description: Check discovered services to confirm Domain Controller availability and determine the path to Phase B.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $d | Out-Null}; $(try { $error.Clear(); $de = New-Object System.DirectoryServices.DirectoryEntry('LDAP://192.168.187.141'); $dn = $de.Properties['defaultNamingContext'].Value; if ($dn) { Write-Output "DC_FOUND: true"; Write-Output "BASE_DN: $dn"; Write-Output "RECOMMENDED_NEXT: ad-enumeration"; Write-Output "PHASE_DONE: false" } else { Write-Output "DC_FOUND: false"; Write-Output "RECOMMENDED_NEXT: escalating-privileges"; Write-Output "PHASE_DONE: true" } } catch { Write-Output "DC_FOUND: false"; Write-Output "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath C:\Windows\Temp\bas\dc_gate.txt

rationale: Verifies Active Directory connectivity and routes the flow to Phase B (ad-enumeration) or lateral movement.
